## Change

State the bounded claim or repository change and its HMH relevance.

## Evidence and review

Link exact source/build identities, reproducible checks and independent review
when research claims change. State what remains unknown.

## Credits and sharing

List new/changed source IDs, applicable notices and the permission basis for
each imported file. Confirm that private inputs are not included.

## Validation

Record the commands actually run and their results. Update the changelog.
